build_seq2reward_trainer: build a Seq2RewardTrainer from a Seq2RewardModel using normalization data and GPU settings
create_seq2reward_model: create a Seq2RewardModel dataclass with default Seq2RewardNetBuilder and FullyConnected compress net builder
get_seq2reward_reporter: get a Seq2RewardReporter instance from a Seq2RewardModel using action names from trainer params
review_seq2reward_model_class: review the Seq2RewardModel class and its build_trainer and get_reporter methods
refactor_seq2reward_net_builder: refactor the Seq2RewardModel to use a custom ValueNetBuilder instead of the default Seq2RewardNetBuilder
